header: This is the one hardened place for every Gemini text/JSON generation call in the app (Executive Deep Synthesis, the NL2SQL model, the intent classifier, the query router). It exists because a review found the first inline version had:
* no timeout (the route's maxDuration is 60 s: Vercel killed the request),
* no control of "thinking" (on Gemini 3 thinking tokens are counted against maxOutputTokens: measured, Pro with a 256 cap answered "{" and stopped with finishReason MAX_TOKENS),
* finishReason never read (a cut-off JSON looked like a normal answer),
* only parts[0] read (a thought part can come first),
* the API key in the URL (it ends up in logs) and the raw error body sent to the browser,
* every failure (even a bad key or a bad request) re-sent the whole prompt to the next model.
My rule for this file: it never throws a message that contains the provider's response body. The details go to the server log, and the caller gets a short safe sentence.

members.name: completion
doc: Answer tokens plus thinking tokens, because thinking is billed as output.

members.name: json
doc: I ask for application/json here (the model then returns bare JSON).

members.name: maxOutputTokens
doc: Answer budget; thinking comes extra on top of this (see thinkingBudgetPad).

members.name: seed
doc: A fixed seed makes repeated calls with the same prompt as alike as the provider allows; a model that rejects it is retried without.

members.name: thinking
doc: I use "low" to keep Pro/Flash fast and to leave the budget for the visible answer. null = provider default.

members.name: models
doc: Models to try in order (first = main). I remove duplicates.

members.name: attemptTimeoutMs
doc: I let one HTTP attempt take at most this long.

members.name: totalTimeoutMs
doc: All attempts together may take at most this long; keep it under the route's maxDuration.

members.name: hedgeAfterMs
doc: Hedge: when the first request has not answered after this long, I send the same request a second time and use the first answer to arrive (the other is dropped). A call that hangs (a model that takes 45 s for what normally takes 12) then costs this long, not its whole timeout. I use it only when it is set; the second request is made only when the first is late, so it costs nothing on a normal call.

members.name: label
doc: Extra label for the server log.

symbols.name: GeminiError
doc: I made this error so that its .message is safe to show to a user; .detail is for the server log only.

members.name: retryable
doc: True when another model might succeed (rate limit, overload, model missing, timeout).

members.sig: constructor(message: string, opts: { status?: number | null; detail?: string; retryable?: boolean } = {})

params.type: { status?: number | null; detail?: string; retryable?: boolean }

symbols.name: THINKING_PAD
symbols.sig: const THINKING_PAD: Record<ThinkingLevel, number> = { minimal: 256, low: 2048, medium: 6144, high: 12288 }
doc: Thinking is billed and counted as output, so I leave room for it: the visible answer must never be cut.

symbols.name: noSeedModels
doc: Models that answered "400 ... seed": I do not ask them for a seed again in this process.

symbols.name: bodyFor
symbols.sig: function bodyFor(prompt: string, req: GeminiRequest, withThinking: boolean, model: string): string

symbols.name: geminiGenerate
symbols.sig: export async function geminiGenerate(prompt: string, req: GeminiRequest): Promise<GeminiReply>
doc: I call Gemini here with a model fallback chain, a per-attempt timeout and a total deadline. My fallback rules: 429 / 5xx / 404 / timeout -> next model. 400 mentioning thinking -> same model once without thinkingConfig. Bad key (401/403) or any other 4xx -> stop at once. A cut-off answer (finishReason MAX_TOKENS) is an error; I never return it as if it were complete.

symbols.name: geminiGenerateOnce
symbols.sig: async function geminiGenerateOnce(prompt: string, req: GeminiRequest): Promise<GeminiReply>

symbols.name: chatModels
doc: Model chains. Each can be overridden from the environment; geminiGenerate removes the duplicates.

symbols.name: synthesisModels
doc: I take the models of the writer of an Executive Deep Search briefing from the environment (GEMINI_SYNTHESIS_MODEL), else the switch PERF.edsDraftModel (src/lib/perf/switches.js; "" = the pro model, the previous way), then the fallbacks.

symbols.name: verifyModels
doc: I take the models of the second reading (the checker) from the environment (GEMINI_VERIFY_MODEL), else the switch PERF.edsVerifyModel ("" = the writer's own chain, the previous way), then the writer's chain as fallbacks.

symbols.name: preferGroq
doc: This decides which provider the app's chat/JSON calls use (see chatLlm in nl2sql/llm.ts): LLM_PROVIDER=gemini | groq explicit choice; otherwise I use Gemini whenever GEMINI_API_KEY exists, and Groq only when it is the only key present.
